lore.title: 侦察记录
lore.zh:
星晶让动物变得狂暴，但它们似乎是在保护地下的根。公会的采矿令，没有告诉我们会伤害整片森林。

星根不是普通矿藏。暴露的星晶让野兽承受过量调谐，森林封路也许是被逼出来的防御。带走第一枚星核，不能等于永远带走森林的生机。
lore.text:
Starcrystals drove the beasts mad. Yet they seem to be defending the roots below. The guild never told us its mines would wound the whole forest.

Starroot is no ordinary ore. Leaking crystals overload the beasts, and the forest's barricade may be a forced defense. Taking the first core into custody must not mean taking the forest's life forever.

lore.title: 遗迹石碑
lore.zh:
碑文写着：先有日，后有月，最后潮水吞没天空。星核从来不是武器，它维系着这片土地。

古代的七处调谐锚点曾让日、月与潮的符号连接水脉。后来有人把共同约定改成了必须盖章的命令，只有机关忘不掉那个顺序。
lore.text:
Sun first, then moon, then tide swallowing the sky. The starcore was never a weapon. It held this land together.

Seven ancient tuning anchors once linked the tide to symbols of sun and moon. Later, a shared ritual was reduced to a stamped command. Only the mechanism remembers the old sequence.

lore.title: 矿工的日记
lore.zh:
统领说堡垒的屏障能保护所有人。可星核抽走了森林、河流和村庄的生机。保护谁，又牺牲谁？

堡垒把抽取星核称为稳定边境，矿工却在每一班供能中失去空气、桥和清水。星陨只是长期失衡在七天前终于露出伤口。
lore.text:
The warden says the citadel shield protects everyone. But the starcore drains the forest, river and villages. Who is protected, and who pays?

The citadel calls its starcore extraction stabilization, while miners lose clean water, bridges and air each shift. Seven days ago, the long imbalance finally broke into visible light.

lore.title: 港口：谁能被写进船册
lore.zh:
水位账目每逢堡垒供能便少一行。补上的字不是数字，而是一个又一个陌生人的名字。

米拉的弟弟给守灯会写过三封信。前两封请求停灯检修，第三封写着：如果你们不能承认代价，就让我把代价带回港口。

白灯为海上船只指路，青灯为落水者留岸。两种灯争同一份零件，记录却不该把任何一方的名字删掉。米拉要带回的是能让三方核对的证词。
lore.text:
A line vanishes from the tide ledger at every shield surge. Its replacement is a name, not a number.

Mira's brother sent three letters. Two asked for repairs. The third: If you cannot admit the cost, let me bring it home.

White lights serve offshore ships; teal lights guide those in the water. Both need parts, yet neither set of names deserves erasure. Mira seeks evidence all sides can audit.

lore.title: 沙海：机器没有忘记
lore.zh:
主人要求蓄光机每天为他预留一杯水。九年过去，城空了，机器仍坚持这条最初的约定。

伊沃在调度单上写：它不是坏了，只是没人告诉它，别人的明天也值得保存。

九年前的主人死后，自动供给指令仍在执行。七日前的星陨让蓄光网更加脆弱，伊沃要做的不是砸坏机器，而是让命令重新接受人的决定。
lore.text:
The master asked the reservoir to keep one cup for him each day. Nine years later the city is empty. The machine keeps its first promise.

Ivo writes: It is not broken. Nobody told it that other people's tomorrows matter too.

The owner died nine years ago, but the reservoir retained its order. Starfall destabilized its light network seven days ago. Ivo wants not to smash the machine but to make its orders accountable again.

lore.title: 高原：钟声之下
lore.zh:
北岸撤离的最后一天，钟阵改用最低的一组频率。声音能压住冰面的裂缝，也能掩盖冰下的人声。

被封存的名单上，有守灯人、摆渡人和山野村民。没有一方独自付出了代价。

真正的修复不能只让钟声变得悦耳。森想记录每一个没能归来的人，保证下一次撤离时再没有人因为被抹去名字而被忘记。
lore.text:
On the final evacuation day, the chimes used their lowest frequencies. The sound could still cracks in the ice, and voices beneath it.

The sealed list holds lamplighters, ferrymen and villagers. No faction paid alone.

Making the bells sound right cannot alone repair the pass. Sen wants each missing person named so the next evacuation will not forget those written out of the record.

lore.title: 杏写给港口孩子的信
lore.en: An's letter to the harbor children
lore.zh:
药草晒干后要放在纸袋里，别装进密封的旧灯罩。受伤的人先用干净水冲洗。

不用谢我。等你们安全回家，就替我在港口种一小块田。药物不应该只沿着堡垒的路送过去。

旧巡路队的最后一项任务不再是找到更多矿脉，而是让药物、食物和人能沿不受许可的路安全往返。
lore.text:
Dry the herbs in paper bags, not old sealed lanterns. Clean wounds with fresh water first.

No thanks needed. When you get home, plant a small harbor garden for me. Medicine should follow more than the road to the citadel.

The roadwardens' last mission was not to locate more ore. It was to keep medicines, food and people moving along roads that no official map would permit.

lore.title: 老潮的旧船票
lore.zh:
这张船票可以换一次免费摆渡。背面写着：没有钱的人，可以用一个故事来付。

老潮年轻时常在雾港讲故事。后来他说不动了，就开始给孩子们煮鱼汤。

无钱的旅客也应该被看见。老潮把一次摆渡记作一则故事的交换，是为后来公会的救援承诺留下实证。
lore.text:
This ticket pays for one ferry crossing. On the back: Those without money may pay with a story.

Old Tide once told stories in Mistport. When words became hard, he began cooking soup for children.

Travelers without coins still deserve passage. Old Tide accepted a story for fare, leaving evidence of a promise the guild would later need to remember.

lore.title: 诺尔的第一张设计图
lore.zh:
水泵的轴心和屏障的供能机，用的是同一种零件。图上有一句划掉的批注：技术没有选边。

下面是他后来添的一句：但拿着图纸的人得选。

零件可以安装在屏障里，也可以装在水泵上。诺尔不再问机器能工作多久，而是问坏掉的地方由谁负责修好。
lore.text:
The water pump and shield generator use the same core part. A crossed-out note reads: Technology takes no side.

Under it, a later addition: But the person holding the drawing must.

A component can strengthen a shield or repair a village pump. Noll no longer asks how long a machine can run, but who must be able to repair what it breaks.

lore.title: 厄洛没有发出的道歉
lore.zh:
我本想等到所有人安全，再告诉他们为此付出了什么。可安全从来没有真正到来，于是我一直没有开口。

如果有人走出了我的城墙，希望他带回来的不是另一面更高的墙。

厄洛的恐惧是真的：他曾亲眼看见没有屏障的人失去家。但靠外围土地供能的城墙，仍无法替那些被排除的人回答什么是安全。
lore.text:
I meant to tell everyone the cost once they were safe. Safety never truly arrived, so I never spoke.

If someone walks beyond my walls, I hope they return with something other than a taller wall.

Orrin's fear is real: he saw families perish without protection. Yet a wall fed by the outer land cannot decide safety on behalf of those it excludes.

lore.title: 密林 · 留在树上的路标
lore.en: Thornwood · a mark in the bark
lore.zh:
莉雅：

我们按采矿令砍掉了两棵老树，荆棘当晚就吞了旧路。韦罗说，森林不是在追我们，是在堵住通向根系的路。

我把这箱食物留在藤封后。能让藤脉安静的人，应该也能听见我们的解释。不要把所有野兽都写成敌人。

——巡路队第三站
lore.text:
Lyra,

We felled two old trees under the mining order. That night, thorns swallowed the road. Vero says the forest is closing the way to its roots rather than chasing us.

I left food beyond the vines. Whoever can quiet them may hear our explanation. Please do not put every beast in the enemy column.

— The patrol, third stop

lore.title: 遗迹 · 没有盖章的渡船票
lore.zh:
这张渡船票从未盖章，背面却画着三座石碑。

巡路员写道：旧城的居民用钟声约定开闸；守门人后来只认公会的印章。有一天，印章丢了，大家就在门外等了一整夜。

票根最后一行是：机关记得次序，人应当记得理由。
lore.text:
This passage was never stamped. Three tablets are drawn on its back.

The road warden writes: the old city opened its sluice to an agreed bell pattern. Later, its keeper demanded a guild seal. When the seal went missing, everyone waited outside all night.

The last line reads: a mechanism remembers the order; people must remember the reason.

lore.title: 矿场 · 少记了一个人的工时
lore.zh:
修理班的工时表上，最后一行被擦掉了。

那位工人没有逃班。他每晚把蓄光机借给住在断桥另一端的妹妹，让她能读完课本。主管说这不算工作，巡路员却替他留了一箱零件。

表格背面写着：机器应当运转；但我们得知道，它在替谁运转。
lore.text:
The final line of the repair crew's timesheet has been erased.

That worker did not abandon his shift. Each night he lent the light engine to his sister across the broken bridge so she could finish her lessons. The overseer said it was not work. A road warden left him a box of spare parts anyway.

On the back: machines should run, but we must know who they run for.

lore.title: 雾港 · 两种颜色的灯
lore.zh:
米拉的前辈在这张航路图上画了两种灯：白灯给船认路，青灯告诉落水的人，岸上还有人在等他。

风暴那晚，巡路队拆下自己的车轴修好了青灯。第二天他们没能继续北上，救上来的人却把名字写满了车厢。

守灯和救人常常争同一份零件。争论之前，先看清灯照向哪里。
lore.text:
Mira's predecessor drew two lights on this chart: white to guide ships, teal to tell people in the water that someone on shore is waiting.

During the storm, the patrol gave up its wagon axle to repair the teal lamp. They could not head north the next day. The people they saved filled the wagon with their names.

A beacon and a rescue may need the same spare part. Before arguing, see where the light falls.

lore.title: 沙海 · 最后一杯水的分法
lore.en: Desert · the last cup of water
lore.zh:
韦罗把最后一杯水分成三份：给赶路的人、给修镜的人，还有一份倒在快要枯死的幼树根旁。

有人笑他，说树不能作证。他回答，等这棵树长出阴影，所有经过的人都会替它作证。

巡路队没有留下更多金币，只留下了这处旧补给。路线的价值，也许不只在终点。
lore.text:
Vero divided the last cup of water three ways: for the traveler, for the mirror keeper, and for the roots of a dying sapling.

Someone laughed that a tree could not testify. He replied that when it grew shade, every traveler resting there would testify for it.

The patrol left no more gold, only this cache. Perhaps a road's value is more than its destination.

lore.title: 高原 · 钟声里的名字
lore.zh:
旧桥的修理册没有英雄画像，只有一列名字。

巡路队到达时，守钟人坚持把遇难者的名字逐个读完。年轻的队员嫌太慢，问为什么不用一句“所有人”。守钟人说：“因为他们不是同一个人。”

莉雅，如果这封信能送到，请把我们的名字也念给家人听。
lore.text:
There are no heroic portraits in the bridge repair book, only a list of names.

When the patrol arrived, the bell keeper insisted on reading every victim's name. A young warden asked why she could not say “everyone.” She answered: because they were not the same person.

Lyra, if this letter reaches you, please read our names to our families too.

lore.title: 旅店的赊账簿
lore.zh:
巡路队失联之后，阿茴把他们家人的名字写进赊账簿，却没有写下要还的钱。

最后一页夹着莉雅留的纸条：“回来的人，先给一碗汤。名单可以慢慢补。”

这家旅店记住的，既是还没寄出的信，也是等人回来的座位。
lore.text:
After the patrol vanished, Ari wrote their families into the credit ledger, but left the debts blank.

Lyra tucked a note into its last page: “Give anyone who returns a bowl of stew first. We can finish the list later.”

The inn keeps a place for unsent letters, and for the people still expected home.
